visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot showing a person's hands pulling apart a crispy, dark-golden puff pastry. Inside, a thick, smooth, pale-yellow custard cream is revealed. The background is slightly blurred, focusing on the texture of the pastry and the creaminess of the filling. (2) Inside a professional kitchen setting, a person wearing a blue thermal glove opens a large stainless steel oven. They slide in a baking sheet with round dough portions and later pull out a tray of perfectly baked, golden-brown puffs with a rough, cracked surface texture. (3) The camera focuses on the finished puffs resting on a black baking mat. Their exterior resembles the crunchy crust of a pineapple bun. The lighting is bright and industrial, emphasizing the golden hues of the baked goods. (4) A gloved hand uses a white rubber spatula to fold a large amount of thick, fluffy white cream in a large stainless steel bowl. The cream appears rich and dense, suggesting a high dairy content. (5) Transition to a retail shop counter. A female staff member wearing a face mask, a branded T-shirt, and a yellow necktie hands a small yellow-checkered paper bag to a customer. The store background features warm wood and shelves with blue gift boxes. (6) A series of quick shots show various promotional items: a black insulated shopping bag with a white cow logo, a purple rectangular box labeled 'MID-AUTUMN FESTIVAL 2023', and small individual blue cookie packets being placed into gift boxes. (7) Close-up of a three-layered sandwich cookie being held up, showing distinct cream layers between thin biscuits. A white insulated travel cup with the brand's logo is also displayed against the store's interior. (8) Two puffs are held up side-by-side in front of a white wall featuring a large 'TOKYO MILK CHEESE FACTORY' logo. The final shot shows the entire storefront with bright lighting and yellow-themed signage.

The BGM remains a consistent layer beneath the vocals, providing a cheerful environment without any audible noise or interference. (3) The narrator highlights the creamy filling and packaging details, maintaining a friendly and inviting prosody. There are brief, rhythmic pauses between sentences that align with the visual cuts of the product being showcased. (4) During the mention of the gift boxes and promotions, the narrator's tone remains authoritative yet warm. The music continues with a simple melodic structure, emphasizing the celebratory theme. (5) The audio concludes with a closing slogan. The narrator's voice has a rising intonation for the sign-off, followed by a slight swell in the BGM volume before a clean cut. The overall production quality is studio-grade.
